title: Get hands-on AI agent and automation training for $19.99
excerpt: Build, automate, and put AI to work.
content_html:
TL;DR: The AI Agent & Business Automation E-Degree is $19.99 (reg. $49) for eight courses covering AI agents, RAG, and business automation.

Credit: Eduonix Learning Solutions

$19.99
$49 Save $29.01

AI skills are becoming increasingly smart and practical, so knowing how to build with the technology can be more useful than simply understanding how it works. The AI Agent & Business Automation Professional E-Degree is on sale for $19.99 (reg. $49), offering eight courses and more than 25 hours of hands-on training.

The curriculum focuses on tools you can actually use to build and automate. You’ll work with ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, LangChain, CrewAI, and OpenAI APIs while learning how to create AI agents and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) applications that can work with your own data.

The courses focus on putting AI agents to work in areas like business operations, marketing, productivity, and workflow automation. You’ll also work with tools such as n8n, Zapier, and Make, as well as APIs and databases using FastAPI, Docker, and GitHub. And despite the technical subject matter, the program isn’t limited to developers.

Entrepreneurs and marketers can use the lessons to automate their work, while business professionals can become more comfortable with how agentic AI works. Developers, meanwhile, can dig further into agent engineering and use the hands-on projects to build out a portfolio.

The program is self-paced with lifetime access, and completing it comes with a certificate that can be added to a résumé or portfolio.

Mashable Deals

By signing up, you agree to receive recurring automated SMS marketing messages from Mashable Deals at the number provided. Msg and data rates may apply. Up to 2 messages/day. Reply STOP to opt out, HELP for help. Consent is not a condition of purchase. See our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use.

Get the AI Agent & Business Automation Professional E-Degree for $19.99 (reg. $49) and spend 25+ hours learning how to build AI agents and put them to work across real business applications.

StackSocial prices subject to change.
